""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_names = set() # Track unique function names # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (Sphinx-style - most structured) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Extract description from adjacent dd element description = "No description found" dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: # Try to get first paragraph for cleaner description first_p = dd.find("p") if first_p: description = first_p.get_text(strip=True) else: description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:250] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), }) # 2. Look for function signatures in headers (h2, h3, h4) for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Look for description in next sibling paragraph description = "No description found" next_p = block.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: description = next_p.get_text(strip=True)[:250] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 3. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names and name.replace("_", "").isalnum(): seen_names.add(name) # Try to find description in parent's next sibling description = "No description found" parent = block.parent if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem and next_elem.name in ["p", "div"]: description = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:250] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) return functions[:30] # Return more functions for better completeness def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] # Extract parameters from signature match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string.strip(): param_parts = param_string.split(",") for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ["self", "cls", "*", "**"]: # Extract name, handling type annotations and defaults param_name = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() # Remove * or ** prefix for *args, **kwargs param_name = param_name.lstrip("*") param_type = "unknown" default_val = None # Extract type if present (name: type) if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = type_part if type_part else "unknown" # Extract default value if present if "=" in part: default_val = part.split("=")[1].strip() if param_name: params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": default_val, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
